```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

triggerR <- new.env()
walk(c("R/read_data.R", "R/remove_future_observations.R"),
     ~ source(.x, local = triggerR))

if (!exists("trigger_5min_wide"))
  trigger_5min_wide <- triggerR$drop_future(
    triggerR$read_5min(format = "wide", only_mean = TRUE))

# Variable order shared by all matrices.
variables <- c(
  "pm1", "pm25", "pm10",
  "pc03", "pc05", "pc1", "pc25", "pc5", "pc10",
  "temperature", "humidity", "pressure", "sound", "light", "uvb",
  "step", "cal",
  "heartrate", "breathrate", "oxygens",
  "bodytemp", "skintemp", "bphigh", "bplow"
)
```

## Co-occurrence

Number of participant–five-minute buckets with both measurements available. Diagonal cells show availability for each measurement.

```{r}
observed <- trigger_5min_wide |>
  select(all_of(variables)) |>
  as.matrix() |>
  is.finite()

cooccurrence_matrix <- crossprod(observed * 1)

cooccurrence <- cooccurrence_matrix |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "variable_1") |>
  pivot_longer(
    -variable_1,
    names_to = "variable_2",
    values_to = "buckets_n") |>
  mutate(
    variable_1 = factor(variable_1, levels = rev(variables)),
    variable_2 = factor(variable_2, levels = variables))

rm(observed)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

ggplot(cooccurrence, aes(variable_2, variable_1, fill = buckets_n)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::label_number(
      accuracy = 0.1,
      scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()
    )(buckets_n)),
    size = 2.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    trans = "sqrt",
    begin = 0.35,
    end = 0.95,
    labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Paired buckets") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```


## Correlations

Pooled Spearman correlations between five-minute means, using pairwise complete observations.

```{r}
correlation_matrix <- trigger_5min_wide |>
  select(all_of(variables)) |>
  cor(method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

correlations <- correlation_matrix |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "variable_1") |>
  pivot_longer(-variable_1, names_to = "variable_2", values_to = "rho") |>
  mutate(
    variable_1 = factor(variable_1, levels = rev(variables)),
    variable_2 = factor(variable_2, levels = variables)
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

ggplot(correlations, aes(variable_2, variable_1, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", rho)), size = 2.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Spearman ρ") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

## Within-participant correlations

Median participant-specific Spearman correlations. Each correlation requires at least 100 paired five-minute buckets.

```{r}
participant_correlations <- trigger_5min_wide |>
  select(userId, all_of(variables)) |>
  group_by(userId) |>
  group_modify(\(.x, .y) {
    x <- as.matrix(.x)
    x[!is.finite(x)] <- NA_real_

    paired_n <- crossprod(!is.na(x) * 1)
    rho <- cor(x, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    rho[paired_n < 100] <- NA_real_

    rho |>
      as_tibble(rownames = "variable_1") |>
      pivot_longer(-variable_1, names_to = "variable_2", values_to = "rho")
  }) |>
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
within_correlations <- participant_correlations |>
  group_by(variable_1, variable_2) |>
  summarise(
    participants_n = sum(!is.na(rho)),
    median_rho = if (all(is.na(rho))) NA_real_ else median(rho, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    median_rho = if_else(participants_n >= 10, median_rho, NA_real_),
    variable_1 = factor(variable_1, levels = rev(variables)),
    variable_2 = factor(variable_2, levels = variables)
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

ggplot(within_correlations, aes(variable_2, variable_1, fill = median_rho)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = if_else(is.na(median_rho), "", sprintf("%.2f", median_rho))),
    size = 2.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Median\nSpearman ρ") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```


## Participant-centered correlations

Pearson correlations between deviations from participant-specific means.

```{r}
# centered_data <- trigger_5min_wide |>
#   select(userId, all_of(variables)) |>
#   group_by(userId) |>
#   mutate(across(all_of(variables), ~ .x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>
#   ungroup()

particles <- c("pm1", "pm25", "pm10",
               "pc03", "pc05", "pc1", "pc25", "pc5", "pc10")

centered_data <- trigger_5min_wide |>
  select(userId, all_of(variables)) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(particles), log1p)) |>
  group_by(userId) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(variables), ~ .x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>
  ungroup()

centered_matrix <- centered_data |>
  select(all_of(variables)) |>
  cor(method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

centered_correlations <- centered_matrix |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "variable_1") |>
  pivot_longer(-variable_1, names_to = "variable_2", values_to = "rho") |>
  mutate(
    variable_1 = factor(variable_1, levels = rev(variables)),
    variable_2 = factor(variable_2, levels = variables)
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10

ggplot(centered_correlations, aes(variable_2, variable_1, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = if_else(is.na(rho), "", sprintf("%.2f", rho))),
    size = 2.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Centered\nPearson r") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```
